svg.title: Local Broadcast for Jellyfin
svg.desc: The plugin's settings page saves stations and teams; the sync service pushes them to the sidecar and registers the sidecar with Jellyfin Live TV as an M3U tuner and XMLTV guide. When Live TV asks for a channel, the sidecar's server has the resolver open the station's page in headless Chrome with media-scraper.js loaded first, finds the live stream, and proxies it back; for local sports it reads team schedules from ESPN. setup: Settings page → SyncService → app.js, LiveTvRegistrar. a channel plays: Jellyfin Live TV → app.js → resolver.js → media-scraper.js, Station websites.
